more_info.overview: Alitame is a high-intensity sweetener with an aspartyl-alanine-derived chemical structure; JECFA identifies both hydrated and unhydrated forms. Its sweetening function is to provide a sweet taste in the finished food. The available identity record does not establish a typical retail-food example for this exact preparation.
